soundItOut.phrase: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart,

soundItOut.gibberish: hoo WIL NAWT SUF-fer YOO too bee TEMP-ted uh-BUV that yee ahr AY-bull;
soundItOut.phrase: who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able;

soundItOut.gibberish: It IZ uv thuh LAWRDZ MER-seez that wee ahr NAWT cun-SOOMD, bee-KAWZ hiz kum-PASH-unz FAYL NAWT.
soundItOut.phrase: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, Because his compassions fail not.

soundItOut.gibberish: Dhuh GRAHSS WITH-uh-reth, dhuh FLOWR FAY-deth: buht dhuh WURD uv owr GAWD shal STAND for EV-uh.
soundItOut.phrase: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

soundItOut.gibberish: iv MAH PEE-pul, wich ahr KAWLD bah MAH NAYM, shal HUM-bul thum-SELVZ, un PRAY, un SEEK mah FAYSS,
soundItOut.phrase: if my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face,

soundItOut.gibberish: thuh WURD uv thuh LAWRD KAYM UN-too AY-brum in uh VIZH-un, SAY-ing, FEER NAWT, AY-brum: Eye am thy SHEELD
soundItOut.phrase: the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield

soundItOut.gibberish: fore thuh ee-JIP-shunz HOOM yee hav SEEN too DAY, yee shall SEE them uh-GEN NOH MAWR fore EV-er.
soundItOut.phrase: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

soundItOut.gibberish: fore WHITH-er THOW GOH-est, Eye WIL GOH; ann WAIR THOW LOJ-est, Eye WIL LOJ:
soundItOut.phrase: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge:

soundItOut.gibberish: buht THY WERD, oh LAWRD, wich HEEL-uth AWL TINGZ.
soundItOut.phrase: but thy word, O Lord, which healeth all things.

soundItOut.gibberish: that thuh kuh-myoo-nih-KAY-shun uv THY FAYTH may bee-KUM ef-FEK-choo-al by thuh ak-NAH-lij-ing uv EV-ree GUUD THING
soundItOut.phrase: that the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing

soundItOut.gibberish: Fore az IT wuz yor MYNDE too GOH uh-STRAY frum GAWD: soh, BEE-ing ree-TURND, SEEK him TEN TYMZ MAWR.
soundItOut.phrase: For as it was your mind to go astray from God: so, being returned, seek him ten times more.

soundItOut.gibberish: fore dhuh TINGZ wich ahr SEEN ahr TEM-puh-ral; buht dhuh TINGZ wich ahr NAWT SEEN ahr ee-TURN-al.
soundItOut.phrase: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

soundItOut.gibberish: dat hee IZ uh ree-WAWR-duh uv dem dat DIL-ih-junt-lee SEEK him.
soundItOut.phrase: that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

soundItOut.gibberish: NOW UN-too him dat IZ AY-bull tuh KEEP yoo frum FAWL-ing, un tuh pri-ZENT yoo FAWLT-less bih-FORE dhuh PREZ-ence uv hiz GLOR-ee
soundItOut.phrase: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory

soundItOut.gibberish: LUUK uh-PAWN thuh HEV-en ann thuh ERTH, ann AWL that IZ thair-IN, ann cun-SID-er that GAWD MAYD them uv THINGZ that wur NAWT;
soundItOut.phrase: look upon the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, and consider that God made them of things that were not;

soundItOut.gibberish: Thuh LAY-ber uv thuh AH-liv shall FAYL, ann thuh FEELDZ shall YEELD noh MEET;
soundItOut.phrase: The labour of the olive shall fail, And the fields shall yield no meat;

soundItOut.gibberish: Ann LET him that IZ uh-THURST KUM. Ann hoo-so-EV-er WIL, let him TAYK thuh WAW-ter uv LYFE FREE-lee.
soundItOut.phrase: And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
